sources.title: Centrian todistusvalinnan tulokset on julkaistu (24.5.2022)
sources.covers: Checked: news item with counts only; no cutoffs

notes: Centria does not appear to publish lowest-accepted-score statistics. Searched: WebSearch in Finnish (pisterajat, alin hyväksytty, alimmat pisteet, valintatilasto, with campus and field names), a scan of the full net.centria.fi sitemap (about 1,660 URLs) for piste/tilasto/alin/todistus/yhteishaku, and the Tietoa hakijalle, Opiskelijavalinta and hakuhelppi pages. None of them has cutoff figures, and Centria's pages do not even point to Vipunen. No 2024-2026 spring or autumn cutoff document was found.
